background-color: #ff5a00; } .switch { --switch-bg: #ff5a00; } Jobs > Level Artist Level Artist Hybrid (Lisbon, Lisbon, Portugal) Summary: Studio Ellipsis is seeking a visionary Level Artist to help shape the visual identity of our new IP, a PC-first cross-platform PvEvP game. This project features a strong and iconic art direction set within a world steeped in deep and rich lore. As a Level Artist, you will pl
items.requirements: ay a crucial role in crafting immersive environments that not only captivate players visually but also enhance the overall gameplay and world-building experience. If you are passionate about creating iconic visuals in a lore-rich universe, we want to hear from you. Responsibilities: ● Environment Creation: Design, model, and texture high-quality 3D environments, ensuring they align with the game’s artistic vision and technical constraints. ● Collaboration: Work closely with level designers to integrate art assets seamlessly into gameplay, ensuring that visuals and mechanics complement each other. ● Visual Storytelling: Incorporate story elements and environmental cues into level design to create rich, immersive worlds. ● Optimization: Optimize assets and environments for performance across multiple platforms, ensuring a smooth and consistent player experience. ● Iteration: Respond to feedback from playtesting and team reviews, refining environments to enhance visual appeal and gameplay flow. ● Documentation: Create and maintain documentation for level art pipelines, including asset lists, reference materials, and best practices. ● Trend Awareness: Stay informed on industry trends, new tools, and techniques in level art, particularly in PvEvP and cross-platform development. Requirements: ● Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Game Art, 3D Art, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. ● Professional Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in level art or environment art, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work on shipped titles. Technical Skills: ● Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Unreal Engine, Unity, Maya, 3ds Max, and Substance Painter/Designer ● Artistic Skills: Strong understanding of color theory, lighting, composition, and visual storytelling in 3D environments. ● Optimization Skills: Experience optimizing assets for performance across various platforms, particularly in large, open-world environments. ● Communication Skills: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including designers, programmers, and narrative writers. ● Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, creativity, and attention to detail. ● Passion for Gaming: A deep love for gaming, particularly in PvEvP and cross-platform genres, with an understanding of current market trends. Hybrid (Lisbon, Lisbon, Portugal)

We’re a small team of world-class creators bound by a singular belief: that imagination, executed with discipline and excellence, can reshape what games and trans
items.requirements: media experiences mean to people. We’re looking for a cross-disciplinary Brand Manager to help shape and scale the worlds we create. This is not a legacy marketing role, it’s a strategic, creative, and executional position for someone who understands how great IPs take root and resonate across formats. You'll work at the intersection of world-building, narrative, brand strategy, and transmedia execution. From comics and digital collectibles to podcasts, games, and physical products, you’ll help ensure each thread connects, and that the brand speaks with one clear voice across all platforms. What You'll Do: Lead the development and execution of brand strategies for our original IPs across media and formats (games, comics, podcasts, digital assets, physical goods, etc). Own the brand lifecycle across multiple verticals, from pitch decks to launch to live ops. Manage external creators, agencies, and production partners to deliver world-class content that aligns with brand tone, world, and goals. Collaborate with internal teams (Creative, Narrative, Production, Social Media and Community) to ensure a unified identity across all channels and expressions. Work with our in-house and external marketing teams to craft campaigns that expand awareness, deepen engagement, and evolve each IP’s universe. Design go-to-market and release strategies that treat the product itself as storytelling, merging brand and narrative into a cohesive experience. Conduct regular brand health checks: audience insights, performance reviews, campaign retrospectives, and translate these into actionable pivots. Stay ahead of the curve on trends in gaming, media, tech, and culture. Track new platforms and narrative formats for IP expansion. Coordinate with legal to safeguard IP, manage licensing, and protect long-term value. Cultivate a collaborative, forward-thinking, globally minded work culture, one that values ideas and execution over ego. What You Bring: 5+ years of experience in brand, IP, or franchise management, ideally in entertainment, games, or media. Demonstrated ability to lead multi-platform storytelling and brand development efforts from 0 to 1 (and beyond). Strong creative instincts and a feel for tone, audience, and positioning. Proven project management chops: timeline ownership, cross-functional coordination, clear reporting. Clear communicator with high emotional intelligence and cross-cultural fluency. Comfortable managing both macro-level strategy and micro-level execution details. Understanding of IP law, licensing models, and brand/IP protection strategies. Data-literate: able to interpret insights and translate them into strategy. A deep love of narrative and a belief in the power of well-executed world-building.
